article.en: When my husband was going into the dining room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
article.zh: 今天早晨，我丈夫走进饭厅时，把一些硬币掉在了地上。

article.en: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
article.zh: 我们找遍了，但没能把它们都找到。

article.en: While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
article.zh: 我们吃早饭时，我们的小儿子汤米在地板上找到了两枚小硬币。

article.en: He put them both into his mouth.
article.zh: 他把两枚硬币都放进了嘴里。

article.en: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
article.zh: 我们俩都试图把硬币取出来，但太迟了。
汤米已经把硬币咽了下去！

article.en: Later that morning, when I was doing the housework, my husband phoned me from the office.
article.zh: 那天上午晚些时候，我做家务时，我丈夫从办公室给我打来电话。

article.en: Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning.
article.zh: 汤米今天上午已经上了三次厕所。

article.en: But I haven't had any change yet!
